newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes higher on exporter deals.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes higher on exporter deals.

text.p: The won closed slightly higher against the dollar on Friday due to exporter settlements and selling pressure stemming from the planned foreign stockholding expansion, dealers said.
The won ended at 892.40 against Thursday's closing of 892.70. It opened at 892.50 and moved from 892.20 to 892.80.

"The tone for the dollar weakened because of dollar supplies from exporters. Expectations of fund inflows ahead of the foreign stock ownership expansion on May 2 also dampened sentiment," said a foreign bank dealer.
Dealers forecast tight-ranged trading on Monday.
